headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Rust Integration
summary: By integrating Rust support, improving dependency resolution, and adding real-time risk assessment features, ClearInstall can better protect users from potential vulnerabilities during installation.
actions: Integrate Rust package management to ensure compatibility and security for Rust projects.
Implement advanced dependency resolution algorithms to minimize false positives in risk assessments.
Add real-time risk alerts for binding.gyp command expansions to enhance user awareness.
